state.label: Liège numerical state · reported order 6 · acs.37.6
state.normalization: Numerically normalized using 100-digit working precision; exact normalization is not claimed.
state.coefficientConvention: Normalized Dicke basis; r counts excitations. Browser values are rounded; downloads retain the saved 85-digit components.

references.title: Independent high-precision checks and import notes

state.provenance: Liège AC-state library · independently checked numerical representative.
state.notes: An older source representative omitted from the previous import was reconstructed from its original Majorana coordinates and refined at its reported sixth order. Its seventh-order residual is about 0.0048. The saved 85-digit coefficients provide numerical evidence, not an exact AC proof or an optimality claim.

verification.method: Independent 100-digit Schmidt-matrix partial traces from the saved 85-digit components, through the next AC order.

audit.sourceMethod: Normalized physical Bloch spinors symmetrized into normalized Dicke coefficients; largest-amplitude global phase made positive. Source coordinate precision is retained only to its original accuracy; 85-digit serialization is not 85-digit source accuracy. Refined at the reported order using 100-digit residuals, then serialized at85digits. Points matched to refined coefficients by110digit local Newton correction.

sourceCoefficientSelection.method: Physical-spinor reconstruction from previously unmanifested original coordinate file; no original Dicke file substituted.

refinement.method: Analytic real Jacobian and fixed approximate right inverse, with100-digit residuals and corrections; no higher-order search.

geometryRefinement.method: 110-digit Newton correction of each simple root from its original sphere point, using reciprocal charts; repeated poles are fixed exactly. This is numerical matching, with an independent Rouché check supplied separately.

audit.scientificStatus: Numerical refinement at the original reported order6 only; not an exact AC certificate or proof of maximality.
